notes.title: Update 1.1.0.9 is now available
notes.content:
- Speed up on screen text 
- Bat now shows sleep image properly
- Added an on-screen message when you can't pick up a ring because you have no free slot in inventory
- Speed up inventory fade effect
- Auto Crit on Sleeping monsters 
- Monsters get to crit a sleeping you.
- No longer able to use inventory when frozen 
- Updated Flattened Pixel logo.  Adjusted intro times
